cc:Work.dc:title: The Bohr shift
cc:Work.dc:description: Two dissociation curves. Lowering pH to 7.2 and raising temperature to 39 degrees moves P50 from 3.5 to about 4.9 kPa. Loading at 13.3 kPa barely changes, but at a muscle PO2 of 2.7 kPa saturation falls from about 33 to 20 percent.
